description: The day's inspiration from the Cazimi app and cazimi.live: two short true stories tied to the calendar date (a person born or died, or an event, on this day in history), one verbatim quote from a public-domain classic (Marcus Aurelius, Epictetus, Seneca, Laozi, Tagore, Emerson, Thoreau and others) with a short reflection, and one traditional parable retold (Aesop, Zen, Sufi, Jataka, folk tales). Each entry ends with a one-line suggestion for today. On Mercury retrograde days the quote and parable are chosen for slowing down and reviewing. Same date, same set; 1,187 entries in English, Spanish, Portuguese, German, French and Ukrainian. Free tool. Each result carries attribution: quote author, work, translator and Project Gutenberg link; stories, reflections and retellings are by Cazimi.

date.description: Date as YYYY-MM-DD, 1900–2100 (the stories follow the month and day). Defaults to today, UTC.

kind.description: Return everything (default), only the two stories, only the quote, or only the parable
